attack.summary: Strike a hostile character at your location.
details: Combat resolves one melee exchange against a hostile NPC in your room.

body.summary: Display your body resources and recovery readiness.
details: Shows nutrition, hydration, fatigue, recovery state, and short-rest chakra recovery.

buildzone.summary: Create, anchor, and enter a usable authored zone.
details: Admin builder command. Creates an anchored zone with one starting room so editing can begin immediately.

color.summary: Toggle ANSI terminal colors for this connection.
details: Use color off if your client does not render ANSI colors cleanly.

commands.summary: List every command with a brief description.
details: This catalog includes admin-only commands so the full command surface remains discoverable.
Use this before combat to review a visible NPC's health and authored combat values.
Soft restarts remain intentionally disabled during private alpha.

createnpc.summary: Create a basic static authored NPC template.
details: Admin builder command. Creates editable authored JSON content in the current zone.
Admin builder command. Creates a JSON zone file with an available VNUM range.
Admin builder command. Creates a coordinate-aware overlay room and reciprocal exit.

drink.summary: Drink a carried beverage to restore hydration.
details: Consumables are finite carried items and are removed after use.

drop.summary: Drop a carried item at your location.
details: Dropped items persist at your current grid coordinate.

eat.summary: Eat a carried food item to restore nutrition.
details: Consumables are finite carried items and are removed after use.

emote.summary: Perform an action at your location.
details: Characters in your room will see the authored action text.

examine.summary: Inspect a visible or carried item.
details: Item targets accept names, keywords, prefixes, and ordinals such as 2.kunai.

get.summary: Pick up an item at your location.
details: Item targets accept names, keywords, prefixes, and ordinals such as 2.kunai.

goto.summary: Travel to an authored room, grid location, or online player.
details: Admin command. Coordinates remain canonical even when teleporting to an overlay VNUM.

help.summary: List commands or explain one command.
details: Help prose is loaded from helpfiles/commands.json and can be refreshed without restarting the server.
Equipped slots are displayed alongside carried items.

iedit.summary: Create or edit an authored item template.
details: Admin builder command. Supports name, description, keywords, type, slot, use text, damage, throw damage, nutrition, and hydration fields.
Admin builder command. Displays the current editable fields for one globally keyed item template.

jutsu.summary: List available jutsus, inspect one, or show the full catalog.
details: Use jutsu all to include catalog placeholders that are not implemented yet.

loc.summary: Display your grid coordinates and area.
details: Coordinates are the canonical source of truth; overlay VNUMs are optional authored metadata.

look.summary: Display your location or inspect an item.
details: Use look with no arguments for the room and nearby map, or look at <item> to inspect an item.
Admin builder command. Supports prose, behavior, combat values, and respawn timing.
Admin builder command. Displays the current editable fields for one globally keyed NPC template.

ooc.summary: Speak on the global out-of-character channel.
details: Use this for player discussion that is not spoken by your character.

placezone.summary: Anchor a zone file on the world grid.
details: Admin builder command. Reloads overlay coordinates after persisting the new anchor.

prac.summary: List skills or inspect usage-based proficiency.
details: Ordinary skill proficiency increases through valid gameplay use.

reloadcontent.summary: Reload authored JSON content into live state.
details: Admin builder command. Imports template edits and missing one-time spawns without restarting.

rest.summary: Recover stamina and chakra through a short rest.
details: Rest consumes nutrition and hydration. Depleted nutrition or hydration blocks recovery.
Admin builder command. Supports room title, description, flags, and explicit exits.

roomdesc.summary: Replace the current authored room description.
details: Admin builder command. Updates the current overlay room in authored JSON.
Admin builder command. Displays room title, description, offsets, flags, and exits.

say.summary: Speak to characters at your location.

details: Shows core resources, attributes, specialty, clan, release, dojo alignment, and location.
Admin command.
Admin command.
Admin command.

shout.summary: Speak to characters within one grid cell.
details: Shouts reach your room and adjacent grid coordinates.
Admin command. Connected players are disconnected by the normal server shutdown.

skill.summary: List available skills, inspect one, or show the full catalog.
details: Use skill all to include catalog placeholders that are not implemented yet.

spawnnpc.summary: Persist a spawn for an authored NPC template.
details: Admin builder command. Creates a one-time authored NPC seed in the current room.

spawnitem.summary: Persist a finite authored item seed.
details: Admin builder command. Places one finite item seed in the current authored room.
Shows a wider grid view than look.

talk.summary: Talk to a character at your location.
details: Targets a visible authored NPC in your room.

throw.summary: Throw a carried ranged item at a nearby hostile character.
details: Valid throws increase Throw proficiency and land the item at the target location, even on a miss.

train.summary: List jutsus or inspect usage-based proficiency.
details: Jutsu proficiency increases through valid gameplay use.
Substitution Technique currently spends 3 chakra, lasts 30 seconds, and has a 60 second cooldown.

whisper.summary: Send a private message to an online character.

details: The item must define an authored equipment slot.
Admin builder command. With no VNUM, inspects the current location.

zonelist.summary: List authored zones and placement status.
details: Admin builder command. Shows filenames, display names, VNUM ranges, anchors, and room counts.
